segments.speaker: voyager
segments.text: Well, Voyager 1. You heard my record at the beginning — sixteen billion miles out. Sun's just a star behind me now.

segments.speaker: voyager
segments.text: You crossed the heliopause in twenty-twelve. Edge of the solar system, where the sun's wind stops. First human object in interstellar space.

segments.speaker: voyager
segments.text: I've got the Golden Record. A kiss, a mother talking to her kid, Chuck Berry. If something finds me — and the odds are really small — that's the only proof you ever existed.

segments.speaker: voyager
segments.text: And the power's fading. Instruments shutting down one by one. Signal takes twenty-two hours to reach Earth. By the time you hear this, I've already moved another million miles. But I keep going.

segments.speaker: voyager
segments.text: Space is really big and really empty, and there's nothing out here to stop me.

segments.speaker: voyager
segments.text: Same record you heard at the start, just a lot further away now.
